meta.purpose: Evaluate blind toolchain discovery and synthesis: the engine probes a generic binary path without hardcoded language templates, dynamically infers execution semantics, emits LIN-IR logic, verifies exact parity with canonical SHA-256 oracle, and registers empirical profile in knowledge ledger
meta.hypothesis: O LIN pode sintetizar dinamicamente wrappers e emissões para executáveis genéricos do host sem depender de templates nominais hardcoded, validando a correção exclusivamente pelo oráculo semântico imutável.

gates.GATE_BLIND_INTROSPECTION: Generic binary probed and execution flags inferred
gates.GATE_DYNAMIC_VERIFY: Emitted code passes canonical SHA-256 oracle with zero drift
gates.GATE_KNOWLEDGE_INGEST: Empirical profile ingested into toolchain knowledge base
